boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named GW destinations for studying, meeting, recreation, performances, and campus-day pauses, with access details checked against current public sources.

cards.title: University Student Center
cards.subtitle: 800 21st St. NW, Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: Use the ground or fourth-floor study areas for a change of scene, and check the building page before planning a meeting or event.
cards.short_summary: A central campus building with study, meeting, presentation, dining, and outdoor space.
cards.evidence_claim: GW identifies the University Student Center as Foggy Bottom’s main hub and says it provides spaces for students to study, work, and socialize.
cards.source_title: University Student Center | Division for Student Affairs | The George Washington University
cards.access_notes: GW lists tap access beginning at 10 p.m. daily; public building hours and event access can change.

cards.title: Gelman Library
cards.subtitle: 2130 H Street NW, Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: Choose a reading lounge, group room, or the Writing Center depending on the task; bring your GWorld card for library access.
cards.short_summary: GW’s main library combines research help with reading lounges and group-study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: GW describes Gelman as its main library, equipped with student and reading lounges, group study rooms, and the University Writing Center.
cards.source_title: Academic Support | School of Medicine and Health Sciences | The George Washington University
cards.access_notes: GW says Gelman access is available to students, faculty, staff, sponsored visiting scholars, and alumni; check library hours separately.

cards.title: Kogan Plaza
cards.subtitle: Mid-Campus Quad & Kogan Plaza, Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: Use this named mid-campus plaza as an outdoor waypoint between nearby buildings, then consult the campus map for the closest accessible entrance.
cards.short_summary: A named plaza within GW’s Mid-Campus Quad destination.
cards.evidence_claim: GW’s virtual-tour map lists “Mid-Campus Quad & Kogan Plaza” as a Foggy Bottom campus location.
cards.source_title: Virtual Tour Map | Explore GW | The George Washington University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access is generally weather-dependent; follow any posted event or campus-use guidance.

cards.title: University Yard
cards.subtitle: University Yard, Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: Make this named outdoor campus stop a meeting point before heading into adjacent academic buildings; use posted routes and accessible entrances.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed outdoor destination on the Foggy Bottom campus.
cards.evidence_claim: GW’s virtual-tour map lists University Yard among its Foggy Bottom campus locations.
cards.source_title: Virtual Tour Map | Explore GW | The George Washington University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access is subject to weather and scheduled campus activity.

cards.title: District House
cards.subtitle: 2121 H Street NW, Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: For a small group gathering, look into eligible B-level space reservations rather than assuming a room is open when you arrive.
cards.short_summary: A named campus building with reservable District House spaces for eligible students and organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: GW states that individual students may reserve B-level District House spaces and that reservations can be made when space is available.
cards.source_title: Student Center Space Requirements | Division for Student Affairs | The George Washington University
cards.access_notes: Reservations and availability rules apply; GW’s building list gives accessible entries from I Street and H Street.

cards.title: Science and Engineering Hall
cards.subtitle: 800 22nd Street NW, Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: If you need a small table-based work session, check the study-space portal for SEH rooms before going; same-day requests are supported.
cards.short_summary: A Foggy Bottom academic building with bookable small study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: GW lists SEH 1230, 1240, 1250, and 1260 as study spaces and says requests may be submitted the same day before the desired time.
cards.source_title: Space Scheduling | GW Events & Venues | The George Washington University
cards.access_notes: Study-space reservations depend on availability; campus-map information lists several accessible SEH entrances.

cards.title: Lerner Health and Wellness Center
cards.subtitle: 2301 G Street NW, Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: Plan a drop-in recreation visit around the facility schedule and bring the required credentials; review Campus Recreation rules before using the space.
cards.short_summary: GW’s recreation facility for eligible students and members.
cards.evidence_claim: GW states that the Lerner Health and Wellness Center is open to GW students and LWHC members for drop-in recreation.
cards.source_title: Campus Rec Facilities & Hours of Operation | Division for Student Affairs | The George Washington University
cards.access_notes: Access is limited to GW students and LWHC members for drop-in recreation; confirm current facility hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: The George Washington University Museum and The Textile Museum
cards.title: GW Museum and The Textile Museum
cards.subtitle: 701 21st Street NW, Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: Set aside time to view the museum’s textile-focused collections, and confirm the day’s visitor details before walking over from campus.
cards.short_summary: A GW museum destination focused on global textiles and related arts.
cards.evidence_claim: GW’s virtual-tour map identifies The George Washington University Museum and The Textile Museum as a Foggy Bottom campus location.
cards.source_title: Virtual Tour Map | Explore GW | The George Washington University
cards.access_notes: Check the museum’s current visitor information for gallery hours, exhibitions, and any access conditions.

cards.title: Lisner Auditorium
cards.subtitle: 730 21st Street NW, Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: Watch the university calendar for a specific performance or campus program, then follow that event’s ticketing and entry instructions.
cards.short_summary: A named Foggy Bottom auditorium and university event venue.
cards.evidence_claim: GW’s virtual-tour map lists Lisner Auditorium as a Foggy Bottom campus location, and GW’s scheduling page includes it in student-organization event portals.
cards.source_title: Space Scheduling | GW Events & Venues | The George Washington University
cards.access_notes: Access is event-specific; a reservation, ticket, or invitation may be required depending on the program.

cards.title: Eckles Memorial Library
cards.subtitle: 2100 Foxhall Road NW, Mount Vernon Campus
cards.notes: Use the library’s computer lab or study space during a Mount Vernon visit, and verify the day’s hours before taking campus transportation.
cards.short_summary: A Mount Vernon library with study space and a 24-hour computer lab.
cards.evidence_claim: GW states that Eckles Library houses a 24-hour computer lab and study space.
cards.source_title: Academic Support | School of Medicine and Health Sciences | The George Washington University
cards.access_notes: GW lists library access for students, faculty, and staff; confirm building and service hours before visiting.

warnings: Several destinations have eligibility, reservation, or event-specific access; verify current details before visiting.
